acceptance_cases.expect: Workshop remains Personal context; opening it grants no Campaign/global creator authority
Personal reusable definition and Campaign variant have independent identity/version and authority
Personal source change does not silently mutate any Campaign variant/instance
Campaign variant edit does not mutate another user's Personal source
Personal asset enters Campaign through explicit proposal/incorporation flow with decision receipt
runtime instantiation rechecks current authority, dependencies, validation and expected versions in owning domain
experiment cannot mutate live Character/Campaign/World/investigation/relationship state or award progression
keeping an experiment creates explicit new draft/template/proposal identity with provenance rather than converting live-like state
comparison uses owning-domain deterministic rules and exact rules/schema/dependency evidence
asset is not silently rewritten; target use fails safely or offers explicit permitted adaptation
independent derivatives/Campaign variants are not silently deleted; reference integrity/tombstones apply as owning domains require
Workshop preserves exact derivative relationship/source-version and source-change evidence without adding sync
Workshop can open a governed promotion/review flow but cannot self-publish or self-promote canonical status
AI can propose creator material only; cannot own mechanics, validation, Campaign mutation or publication
offline state does not broaden authority and Sandbox cannot use offline status to commit Campaign mutations
search/count/usage/similarity filters authorization before aggregation and cannot reveal protected Campaign existence/cardinality
create, compare, propose, sandbox, save and lifecycle review all work through keyboard/screen-reader/list/text UI
